$269,900, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,216 SF, MLS# 587055

Opportunity Acres! If you're searching for exceptional value in rural property, don't pass up seeing this perfect blend of seclusion and natural beauty with this 14.7-acre property, located estimated 15 minutes Southwest of Gatesville, TX (near the King community). Hidden away down a long winding, paved driveway, mostly wooded property offers unmatched privacy, wildlife, and quite peace of mind. At the heart of the property sits a 1995 model manufactured home featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and over 1,200 square feet of living space an oversized wood deck with handicap ramp leading up to the front door. Whether you're seeking a weekend retreat or just peaceful country living, this property offers endless potential to create your personal memories. Don’t miss the chance to own your share of Texas!

2 full bath
